authority: apostila-cga-2026; adversarial review round 1, gaps G2 and G8
method: exhaustive count of `atenção` in the corpus; full reseal of every declared release hash
reason: A safety-manual concept inherited from the controlled-language seed was claiming ordinary Portuguese prose, and the release seal covered only the three files the sealer rewrote.

operations.why: risk.caution carries `domains: [documentation, safety]` and means a notice about equipment or process harm. Its Portuguese preferred label was `atenção`, whose single corpus occurrence is `são pontos de atenção quando se utiliza relatórios de terceiros` — ordinary Portuguese for `things to watch`. The technical-manual term is `cuidado`, which occurs zero times here, so the concept keeps a correct label and stops claiming common prose. Same shape as state.enabled claiming `ativo`: a seed-vocabulary concept whose label is an everyday word in the target domain.
